generator: OpenAI built-in image generation plus authored semantic SVG

rooms.layout: six rooms, five stable semantic locations per room
rooms.purpose: Calm walkable home route with hotspots only on recognizable furniture and fixtures

prompts.portraits: Twenty-four original distinct fictional adult portrait headshots; exact 6 by 4 contact sheet; differentiated face shapes, ages, hair, glasses, facial hair and skin tones; consistent editorial cut-paper and soft clay style; no text, celebrity likeness, emoji, logos or watermark.
prompts.objects: Five exact 6 by 4 atlases covering all 120 named HANNA_OBJECTS in row-major order; one centered, recognizable object per cell; warm editorial clay and cut-paper illustration; no text, logo, emoji or watermark.
prompts.pegs: Exact 6 by 4 atlas; first twenty cells contain the explicit 1-20 mnemonic peg objects from candle through target; four decorative filler stars; no text or digits.

provenance.rooms: Authored SVG. The discarded generated single-room draft is not shipped or referenced.
provenance.bitmapArt: Generated once with the built-in image generation tool, then cropped to stable static assets.
provenance.claim: Curated static learning illustrations; the application does not generate images at runtime.
